scripts.deploy:build: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$d='dist'; if(Test-Path $d){Remove-Item $d -Recurse -Force}; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $d\css,$d\js | Out-Null; Copy-Item index.html $d\index.html -Force; Copy-Item css\style.css $d\css\style.css -Force; Copy-Item js\app.js,js\auth.js,js\charts.js,js\data.js,js\ui.js $d\js\ -Force"
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=amaris-catering --branch=main
